services.heading: Furniture for every corner of your home
services.subtitle: We design and produce custom furniture directly in our Chișinău workshop. Every piece is made with attention to detail, tailored precisely to your space.
services.kitchens_desc: From modern minimalist to classic elegant — every kitchen is designed for your space, taste and budget. Premium materials, European hardware.
services.wardrobes_desc: Built-in, sliding or hinged door storage systems. Fully customized interiors for clothes, accessories and everything you need organized.
services.bedrooms_desc: Full bedroom sets: upholstered or solid wood bed, bedside tables, dresser, wardrobe — all united by a coherent design and durable materials.
services.living_desc: TV units, bookcases, dining tables and furniture pieces that transform your living room. Functional, aesthetic and designed for everyday life.

cta_banner.heading: Have an idea? Let's turn it into reality.
cta_banner.subtitle: Free consultation, 3D design and quality production — all under one roof.

process.heading: From idea to reality in 4 steps
process.subtitle: A simple, transparent, result-oriented process. You're informed at every stage, no surprises.
process.step1_desc: We meet, discuss your needs, take measurements and understand your desired style. All free, no obligations.
process.step2_desc: Our designer creates detailed 3D visualizations of your furniture. We review and adjust until you're 100% satisfied.
process.step3_desc: Our team produces the furniture in our Chișinău workshop using quality materials and precision CNC.
process.step4_desc: We deliver and install the furniture at your home with care, including final inspection and cleanup.
process.banner_sub: First consultation is completely free. No commitments.
